I rent this small plot near town to grow vegetables for the market. The soil here is sandy and weak, but I will not spend money on chemical fertilizer for land that is not mine — one bag is already too much for 0.28 hectares and the cash must go to food and school fees instead. I will spread some chicken manure and compost I got cheap from a neighbor to help the soil, and my wife and I will do all the hoeing, planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves. I am not buying improved seed or pesticides this season; I will use seed I saved from last season and pull the weeds by hand, because on a rented plot I cannot afford to take risks with borrowed money.
